publication: Arnold W. Miller, The maximum principle in forcing and the axiom of choice, author manuscript dated June7,2011, 14 pages.

reviews.checked_passages: pp.1–3: maximum principle statement, maximal-antichain proof and dependence on choosing a family of witness names; mixing construction referred to Kunen in the source.
reviews.outcome: No serious defect confirmed in the adopted statement and maximal-antichain argument. The corpus supplies the full exact spliced-name constructor and valuation proof, and distinguishes ground-model Choice/Collection and ground dense-test/name membership from ambient choice of objects. The adjacent equivalence with Choice and later choiceless forcing examples are not adopted or certified.
